description:
**Original Webtoon: **  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=787729), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8061860)  
Ordinary middle school student 'Lee Dae-ah' wanted to run away from home and applied to any boarding high school.  However, it turned out that this was a magic school disguised as an art high school, and the secrets related to 'Lee Dae-ah' are beginning to be revealed at this school, which I thought was completely irrelevant!
